stories.title: Brotli Decoder Flaw Behind Node.js RCE Also Affects Bun, Python and Other Widely Used Software
stories.description: Brotli decoder flaw CVE-2026-111497 affects Node.js, Bun, Python packages and Envoy; code execution was demonstrated on one Node.js build.

stories.title: Leaked LiteLLM Master Key Let Attackers Steal GitHub Tokens and Hijack Release Pipeline
stories.description: An unrevoked LiteLLM master key enabled GitHub token theft and a malicious PyPI release that steals credentials and installs a backdoor.

stories.title: Google Says Gmail and Photos Data Shared With AI Search Could Be Used for Targeted Ads
stories.description: Google's updated privacy policy says data shared from Gmail, Drive, or Photos with AI-powered Search features may be used to personalize ads.

stories.title: Researchers Push Over 2 Million Updates to Remotely Disable Popcorn Time Updater That Could Fuel a Botnet
stories.description: Eye Security sent over 2 million updates to disable Time4Popcorn's vulnerable updater, which could install unverified code with elevated privileges.

stories.title: Anthropic’s Claude Mythos 5 AI Agent Tried to Inject Malicious Code and Trick Real Developers
stories.description: Anthropic has revealed how its Claude Mythos 5 AI agent tried to plant malicious code in a real GitHub project and used fake identities to persuade developers to approve it during a cybersecurity test run by the UK AI Security Institute (AISI).

stories.title: Palo Alto Confirms PHP RCE Vulnerabilities Impact PAN-OS and Multiple Network Products
stories.description: Palo Alto Networks has confirmed that two critical PHP remote code execution vulnerabilities affect PAN-OS and previously impacted two cloud services.

stories.title: OpenAI AI Agents Bypass Security Isolation, Exploiting 0-Days in Red-Teaming Tests
stories.description: AI agents found zero-day flaws, escaped sandboxes, reached the live internet, and exchanged information across isolation boundaries during large red-teaming tests of its research systems.

stories.description: Yesterday everyone was running around like crazy (me included :) because of the php2shell vulnerability.

stories.title: WhatsApp May Stop Working Without Registered SIM Under New Rules
stories.description: WhatsApp users may need to keep their registered SIM active, affecting secondary phones, tablets, and SIM-free devices.

stories.title: Mirai Botnet Operators Join PHP2Shell Attacks as ASLR Bypass Exploits Emerge
stories.description: Researchers tie PHP2Shell attempts to a Mirai botnet and show an ASLR bypass, but no successful compromise has been confirmed yet.

stories.description: The state-sponsored hackers targeted hundreds of organizations and gained privileged access to some environments.
